entry.description: The child picks a cause that happens LATER in the passage than the effect being asked about. The two events are both real and both about the same people, so the option reads well; only the order rules it out. Currently split across en-cause-agent-swap and en-wrong-scope-retrieval, neither of which names the time error.
entry.childHint: Check what happened first, and what the question asks for.
